text:
Ajay: 🚨 Datadog alert - 95th latency for /v1/chat is spiking from 200ms -> 1.8s and 5xx rate creeping up (model=cedar-alpha-2026-v2). Seen across eu-west and us-east. Paging oncall @here

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4221 triggered: SEV2 - model latency spike. Assigned to Marta (oncall-sre). Link: https://datadog/app/trace/cedar-alpha-2026-v2

Marta (oncall-sre): taking it. timeline? impact on customers? any recent deploys?

Ajay: no deploys in last 30m. Traffic jump from a few heavy API keys (key-prod-42, key-partnerX). Error type: connection timeout to runtime pods -> grpc deadline_exceeded, but also 502 from router when runtime returns error. Dashboard: https://redwood.example.com/dashboards/cedar-latency

Simon: looks like cedar-alpha-2026-v2 is the canary variant we rolled last night. If runtime is timing out under short bursts we should divert traffic to cedar-stable-2025 and reduce heavy-key quotas. Suggest steps: 1) remove cedar-alpha from routing weights 2) apply soft quota for top keys 3) set emergency fallback policy to stable.

Marta (oncall-sre): agreed. I'll do (1) now.

Marta (oncall-sre): patching routing to drain variant -> will redirect new requests to cedar-stable-2025. Command: ```bash
# admin API
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/models/cedar-alpha-2026-v2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"target_weight":0, "reason":"auto-drain-sev2-latency-spike"}'
```

deploy-bot: routing update accepted. cedar-alpha-2026-v2 weight -> 0. New traffic split: cedar-stable-2025 (100%). Rollout ID: r-20260315-91

Elaine: are we expecting model-change regressions? any evals for stable -> alpha differences? If we move to stable will outputs degrade for some partners?

Simon: cedar-alpha is slightly higher quality for open-ended summary but not critical for partnerX workloads (mostly Q+A). fallback to stable is low-risk. We should still monitor hallucination/regression metrics for top 5 keys.

Marta (oncall-sre): applying per-key soft quotas to throttle noisy keys to 30% of their usual rate to buy headroom. Command: ```bash
# adjust quotas for keys
for k in key-prod-42 key-partnerX key-batch-7; do
  curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/quotas/$k" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"type":"soft","limit_pct":30,"window_sec":60,"reason":"emergency-throttle-sev2"}'
done
```

incident-bot: Quota adjustments applied for key-prod-42, key-partnerX, key-batch-7.

Ajay: after drain + throttles latency 95th dropped to ~320ms, 5xx rate down from 1.8% -> 0.3%. Good so far.

Kevin: I'll open a public status page update: "We are investigating elevated latency for chat endpoints; mitigation in progress - traffic routed to stable variant; some heavy keys rate-limited." Posting now.

support-bot: Created support ticket INC-2903 and attached current dashboard snapshots and impacted keys list. Notifying CSMs for top-2 partners.

Elaine: good. We should still schedule postmortem and check the alpha runtime logs for OOMs or GC stalls. Marta, can you collect top pod logs and heap/GRPC metrics?

Marta (oncall-sre): grabbing logs now. sample command: ```bash
kubectl -n runtime logs -l model=cedar-alpha-2026-v2 --since=30m | gzip > /tmp/cedar-alpha-logs.gz
scp /tmp/cedar-alpha-logs.gz ops@redwood-internal:/tmp/incident-2903/
```

Marta (oncall-sre): quick grep shows repeated deadlines and `kv-cache full` warnings on some pods, plus intermittent tls handshake errors to GPU host in eu-west-1. Saving full logs to INC-2903.

Simon: kv-cache full could indicate our KV eviction policy not keeping up with longer prefixes from this workload. Might need to tune max-kv-items or evict more aggressively, but that's a post-incident change. For now the routing + quotas are the right mitigation.

Ajay: notify top partners that we rolled them back to stable and rate-limited temporary to avoid errors. CSMs updated?

support-bot: CSMs notified for partnerX and prod-42. Template message posted to their watchlist.

Marta (oncall-sre): adding action items to incident ticket:
- immediate: drained cedar-alpha-2026-v2, applied per-key soft quotas, posted status page, notified CSMs (done)
- near-term: collect runtime logs, check GPU host tls/IO, confirm kv-cache metrics and eviction behavior
- follow-up: revert quotas only after sustained normal latencies for 12h, plan runtime config tweak if kv-cache issue confirmed

Kevin: I'll coordinate the postmortem and schedule follow-up with runtime team and ML model owners. Putting a calendar invite for 1pm UTC tomorrow.

Ajay: thanks team. For tracking: PD-4221 -> INC-2903. If latency creeps back up or errors reappear, re-open PD and escalate to SEV1.

Marta (oncall-sre): closing live mitigation loop for now. Will keep monitoring dashboards and will update thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD-4221 status: mitigated -> monitoring. If new alerts trigger, pager will re-escalate.

Marta (oncall-sre): final note — avoid re-enabling cedar-alpha-2026-v2 until we confirm kv-cache improvements and confirm stability in eu-west pipeline. Adding model owners to follow-up ticket.
